summary: Iridium Communications filed an 8-K disclosing a Consent and Amendment No. 4 to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, tied to its pending merger with Rocket Lab Corporation announced June 28, 2026. The amendment states the transaction will not constitute a Change of Control, secures requisite lender consent, adds a downstream guarantee by Rocket Lab USA, Inc. at closing, and increases interest rate pricing effective post-closing. No per-share merger consideration, premium, or closing date appears in this excerpt. Watch regulatory clearances and financing conditions before the two-step merger closes.
